jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
The Land Conservancy of San Luis Obispo County
 is a local, private, non-profit land trust working to conserve and care for the diverse wildlands, farms, and ranches of the Central Coast. We connect people to the land and to each other. The organization strives to create a fun, inspiring, and family–friendly work environment with flexible work hours, a team-oriented structure, and good benefits. The organization has received the 2024 Blue Diamond Family-Friendly Workplace award, the highest available, from SLO County's Chamber of Commerce.

The Field Technician 
position is a seasonal (6-Months, temporary), full time position as a member of The Land Conservancy’s 4-person Field Crew that is an integral part of the on-the-ground implementation of restoration and stewardship projects. Field Technician duties include invasive plant management utilizing herbicide, land stewardship and maintenance, native plantings and landscape maintenance, and other tasks as directed.
The Field Technician position runs from October 26th, 2026 to April 23th, 2027. The exact duration of the position may change based on project need and/or funding.
This is a full-time, seasonal position that includes: Three (3) days or 24 Hours Paid Time Off (PTO) per season and paid holidays.

Please visit our website for the full job description and online application link:

https:/​/​lcslo.org/​careers
Incomplete applications will not be considered.  

Required Qualifications - Job Skills and Knowledge

1. A commitment to the mission of The Land Conservancy which is to permanently protect and enhance lands having important scenic, agricultural, habitat and cultural values for the benefit of people and wildlife.
2. Willingness to work with and spray herbicide/chemicals on a regular basis.
3. Ability to read and understand warning labels and follow instructions on equipment, restrictions on the use of chemicals, and training documents related to the use of equipment and chemicals.
4. Experience with the use of hand tools such as shovels and hoes, and power tools such as drills and saws.
5. Experience with mechanical equipment – ability to safely start, run, and make minor repairs.
6. Experience in the area of plant installation, irrigation, and landscape maintenance.
7. Ability to safely drive 4-wheel drive trucks and OHV’s on rough, narrow, steep, or sandy terrain.
8. Ability to walk 5 miles per day in the dune environment. This includes walking on soft ground and climbing steep sand dune hillsides with a backpack sprayer and/or other field equipment.
9. The ability to lift 35 lbs. repeatedly as part of daily activities.
10. Ability to manage one’s susceptibility to allergies that could result from exposure to dust or pollen.
11. Final candidates must undergo a standard physical examination and provide proof of such to The Land Conservancy prior to being hired. Conditional employment offers will be based on successful completion of the pre-employment medical exam.

About Prophetic

Real estate development is a multi-billion-dollar industry that has run on fragmented data, manual processes, and gut instinct for decades. Prophetic is changing that. We're building the AI-native platform that enables homebuilders, developers, and investors to find, analyze, and act on land opportunities from a single system — powered by proprietary technologies that process billions of data points across all 50 states. We are the market leader in our space, and our customers don't just use the product — they love it. We're not making teams more efficient. We're changing how they operate.

Prophetic is scaling fast — demand is outpacing our ability to hire, and we're just getting started. This is a once-in-a-lifetime team: sharp, low ego, deeply collaborative, and obsessed with building the best product in the industry. Come disrupt an industry with us.

About The Role

As Prophetic scales into the enterprise, our customers need more than a product demo — they need a technical partner who can understand their workflows, configure the platform for their specific use cases, and ensure they realize maximum value from day one. We're looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to bridge the gap between our product and our most complex enterprise customers.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, product, and engineering. During the sales cycle, you'll lead technical discovery, run customized product demonstrations, answer complex technical questions, and build proof-of-concept configurations. Post-sale, you'll support enterprise onboarding, work with Account Management on technical escalations, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product and Engineering.

Prophetic's platform processes geospatial data, zoning information, parcel ownership records, and AI-generated insights across all 50 states. Enterprise customers often have unique data requirements, API integration needs, and workflow configurations. You'll be the person who ensures those requirements are understood, scoped, and delivered.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll be in the room for our most strategic enterprise deals and directly influence how we win and retain our largest customers.

What You'll Do

Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise prospects during the sales cycle.
Deliver customized product demonstrations tailored to each prospect's markets, workflows, and use cases.
Answer complex technical questions about platform architecture, data coverage, API capabilities, and integration options.
Build proof-of-concept configurations and custom demos that showcase platform value for specific customer scenarios.
Support enterprise onboarding by translating customer requirements into platform configurations, API integrations, and workflow setups.
Partner with Account Management on technical escalations, data accuracy issues, and feature requests for strategic accounts.
Serve as the technical voice of the customer — translating field insights into product requirements and engineering priorities.
Create and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, and solution architecture diagrams for enterprise customers.
Travel to customer sites for in-person discovery sessions, onboarding, and strategic reviews.
Leverage AI tooling daily for research, demo preparation, and technical documentation.

What You Need

5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical consulting at a B2B SaaS company.
Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, databases, data pipelines, and system architecture with both engineers and executives.
Experience leading technical discovery and running customized enterprise product demonstrations.
Excellent presentation and communication skills — you can command a room of C-suite executives and explain complex concepts clearly.
Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles with multi-stakeholder buying processes.
Comfort with data — you can write SQL queries, navigate datasets, and understand data quality issues.
Self-starter who can manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously.
Comfort with AI tooling as part of your daily workflow.
Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

Nice To Have

Experience with geospatial data, GIS, or map-based platforms.
Background in real estate, construction, homebuilding, or proptech.
Experience building API integrations or working with enterprise data warehouse teams.
Background at an early-stage or high-growth startup where you helped define the solutions engineering function.
Familiarity with Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, or similar technical tools.

Why Prophetic

The team. Wide expertise, sharp, low ego, and genuinely fun to work with. We have each other's backs and we celebrate wins together.
Real ownership and impact from day one. Our customers make million-dollar decisions on our platform. Your work matters immediately.
AI-native product and AI-native workflows. Every team — engineering, sales, operations — runs on AI tooling daily.
Founder-led transparency. Leadership shares the financials, the strategy, and the hard calls with the whole team.
High growth, high demand. The product works, customers love it, and we are hiring to keep up. No shortage of opportunity here.
Flexibility. Remote, hybrid, or in-office with a great Portland, OR headquarters.
Self-starters who thrive in ambiguity. We're a startup. If you need someone to tell you what to do every morning, this isn't the place; if you come alive solving hard problems with smart people, it is.

100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you; 30% coverage for dependents

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automate recurring analysis, strengthen data quality, and enhance project governance.

Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data, business context, and project outcomes.
Clear communicator who can simplify complex analysis for senior leaders, project teams, and operational stakeholders.
Detail-oriented and disciplined in data validation, documentation, follow-through, and quality of deliverables.
Collaborative working style with the ability to build trust across functions, regions, and levels of the organization.
Curious and proactive in identifying better ways to organize, analyze, visualize, and use data to support project delivery.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple priorities, shifting deadlines, and ambiguity.
Outcome-focused, with a practical understanding of how analytics supports execution, operational excellence, and business impact.

Our global network of 80+ laboratories is constantly evolving, because the world around us is always changing. We are seeking a motivated and hands-on Field Technician I to join our team and support engineering, environmental services, materials testing, and inspection projects. In this role, you will conduct on-site inspections, materials testing, and environmental sampling to ensure construction, infrastructure, and environmental projects meet industry standards and regulatory requirements.

As a Field Technician I, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gaining practical field experience, developing technical skills, and contributing to critical projects that impact communities. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and thrives in outdoor work environments, solving challenges in real time and collaborating with a team. Perform other duties as assigned to support project goals and company initiatives.

About The Company

Indiana University (IU) School of Medicine's Department of Medical and Molecular Genetics is one of the pioneering human genetics departments in the country. With a storied history of training geneticists and genetic counselors, the department has established itself as a leader in providing comprehensive genetic consultation and counseling services. Currently ranked fifth nationally among Genetics Departments for National Institutes of Health (NIH) funding received in 2023, the department is at the forefront of genetic research and clinical application. Its contributions span basic research into genetic and genomic mechanisms, translational studies in disease models, and clinical trials targeting both rare and common genetic disorders. The department’s mission is to advance understanding, diagnosis, and treatment of genetic conditions through innovative research, education, and clinical excellence.

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our dynamic team at Indiana University’s Department of Medical and Molecular Genetics. This role involves developing, testing, maintaining, and troubleshooting software solutions and research data workflows to support ongoing genetic research projects. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with investigators, research staff, and technical stakeholders to translate complex study requirements into secure and reliable technical solutions. Responsibilities include designing and optimizing database queries, supporting data pipelines, automating workflows, and ensuring the integrity and security of sensitive research data. The role also entails documenting technical processes, assisting in troubleshooting issues related to software and data management, and providing insightful data analysis to support research objectives. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge genetic research, leveraging advanced data analysis techniques and technologies to further scientific discovery.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information science, or a related field
Minimum of 2 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or related roles
Experience supporting research, healthcare, scientific, or data-intensive environments (preferred)
Proficiency in Python programming for developing data solutions
Strong SQL skills, including writing, troubleshooting, and optimizing complex queries
Experience with database platforms such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Microsoft SQL Server
Knowledge of data integration, ETL/ELT processes, and automated workflows (preferred)
Understanding of security, privacy, and data governance practices for sensitive data
Excellent communication skills and professionalism
Strong time management, accuracy, and dependability
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Self-directed with a proactive approach to learning and problem-solving (preferred)

 is a local, private, non-profit land trust working to conserve and care for the diverse wildlands, farms, and ranches of the Central Coast. We connect people to the land and to each other. The organization strives to create a fun, inspiring, and family–friendly work environment with flexible work hours, a team-oriented structure, and good benefits. The organization has received the 2024 Blue Diamond Family-Friendly Workplace award, the highest available, from SLO County's Chamber of Commerce.

The Field Technician 
position is a seasonal (6-Months, temporary), full time position as a member of The Land Conservancy’s 4-person Field Crew that is an integral part of the on-the-ground implementation of restoration and stewardship projects. Field Technician duties include invasive plant management utilizing herbicide, land stewardship and maintenance, native plantings and landscape maintenance, and other tasks as directed.
The Field Technician position runs from October 26th, 2026 to April 23th, 2027. The exact duration of the position may change based on project need and/or funding.
This is a full-time, seasonal position that includes: Three (3) days or 24 Hours Paid Time Off (PTO) per season and paid holidays.

Please visit our website for the full job description and online application link:

https:/​/​lcslo.org/​careers
Incomplete applications will not be considered.  

Required Qualifications - Job Skills and Knowledge

1. A commitment to the mission of The Land Conservancy which is to permanently protect and enhance lands having important scenic, agricultural, habitat and cultural values for the benefit of people and wildlife.
2. Willingness to work with and spray herbicide/chemicals on a regular basis.
3. Ability to read and understand warning labels and follow instructions on equipment, restrictions on the use of chemicals, and training documents related to the use of equipment and chemicals.
4. Experience with the use of hand tools such as shovels and hoes, and power tools such as drills and saws.
5. Experience with mechanical equipment – ability to safely start, run, and make minor repairs.
6. Experience in the area of plant installation, irrigation, and landscape maintenance.
7. Ability to safely drive 4-wheel drive trucks and OHV’s on rough, narrow, steep, or sandy terrain.
8. Ability to walk 5 miles per day in the dune environment. This includes walking on soft ground and climbing steep sand dune hillsides with a backpack sprayer and/or other field equipment.
9. The ability to lift 35 lbs. repeatedly as part of daily activities.
10. Ability to manage one’s susceptibility to allergies that could result from exposure to dust or pollen.
11. Final candidates must undergo a standard physical examination and provide proof of such to The Land Conservancy prior to being hired. Conditional employment offers will be based on successful completion of the pre-employment medical exam.

About Prophetic

Real estate development is a multi-billion-dollar industry that has run on fragmented data, manual processes, and gut instinct for decades. Prophetic is changing that. We're building the AI-native platform that enables homebuilders, developers, and investors to find, analyze, and act on land opportunities from a single system — powered by proprietary technologies that process billions of data points across all 50 states. We are the market leader in our space, and our customers don't just use the product — they love it. We're not making teams more efficient. We're changing how they operate.

Prophetic is scaling fast — demand is outpacing our ability to hire, and we're just getting started. This is a once-in-a-lifetime team: sharp, low ego, deeply collaborative, and obsessed with building the best product in the industry. Come disrupt an industry with us.

About The Role

As Prophetic scales into the enterprise, our customers need more than a product demo — they need a technical partner who can understand their workflows, configure the platform for their specific use cases, and ensure they realize maximum value from day one. We're looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to bridge the gap between our product and our most complex enterprise customers.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, product, and engineering. During the sales cycle, you'll lead technical discovery, run customized product demonstrations, answer complex technical questions, and build proof-of-concept configurations. Post-sale, you'll support enterprise onboarding, work with Account Management on technical escalations, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product and Engineering.

Prophetic's platform processes geospatial data, zoning information, parcel ownership records, and AI-generated insights across all 50 states. Enterprise customers often have unique data requirements, API integration needs, and workflow configurations. You'll be the person who ensures those requirements are understood, scoped, and delivered.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll be in the room for our most strategic enterprise deals and directly influence how we win and retain our largest customers.

What You'll Do

Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise prospects during the sales cycle.
Deliver customized product demonstrations tailored to each prospect's markets, workflows, and use cases.
Answer complex technical questions about platform architecture, data coverage, API capabilities, and integration options.
Build proof-of-concept configurations and custom demos that showcase platform value for specific customer scenarios.
Support enterprise onboarding by translating customer requirements into platform configurations, API integrations, and workflow setups.
Partner with Account Management on technical escalations, data accuracy issues, and feature requests for strategic accounts.
Serve as the technical voice of the customer — translating field insights into product requirements and engineering priorities.
Create and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, and solution architecture diagrams for enterprise customers.
Travel to customer sites for in-person discovery sessions, onboarding, and strategic reviews.
Leverage AI tooling daily for research, demo preparation, and technical documentation.

What You Need

5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical consulting at a B2B SaaS company.
Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, databases, data pipelines, and system architecture with both engineers and executives.
Experience leading technical discovery and running customized enterprise product demonstrations.
Excellent presentation and communication skills — you can command a room of C-suite executives and explain complex concepts clearly.
Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles with multi-stakeholder buying processes.
Comfort with data — you can write SQL queries, navigate datasets, and understand data quality issues.
Self-starter who can manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously.
Comfort with AI tooling as part of your daily workflow.
Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

Nice To Have

Experience with geospatial data, GIS, or map-based platforms.
Background in real estate, construction, homebuilding, or proptech.
Experience building API integrations or working with enterprise data warehouse teams.
Background at an early-stage or high-growth startup where you helped define the solutions engineering function.
Familiarity with Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, or similar technical tools.

Why Prophetic

The team. Wide expertise, sharp, low ego, and genuinely fun to work with. We have each other's backs and we celebrate wins together.
Real ownership and impact from day one. Our customers make million-dollar decisions on our platform. Your work matters immediately.
AI-native product and AI-native workflows. Every team — engineering, sales, operations — runs on AI tooling daily.
Founder-led transparency. Leadership shares the financials, the strategy, and the hard calls with the whole team.
High growth, high demand. The product works, customers love it, and we are hiring to keep up. No shortage of opportunity here.
Flexibility. Remote, hybrid, or in-office with a great Portland, OR headquarters.
Self-starters who thrive in ambiguity. We're a startup. If you need someone to tell you what to do every morning, this isn't the place; if you come alive solving hard problems with smart people, it is.

Benefits (US-based Full-time)

100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you; 30% coverage for dependents
Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity
Unlimited PTO
Hybrid/Remote stipend
In-office perks: snacks, drinks, coffee, ping-pong table, and more — plus cuddles from Olive, our in-office Doberman!
Budget for intra-office travel
2–3 annual team meetups in person

How We Work

These four themes are how we think, build, and lead:

Truth — Say the hard thing. We speak plainly, flag problems early, and share what's actually going on.
Precision — Sign your name to it. Our customers make million-dollar decisions on our data. We get the details right.
Velocity — Speed compounds. Waiting doesn't. We ship daily and launch features every two to three weeks.
Ownership — Own it, then solve it. We own outcomes, not tasks. If something's broken, we fix it.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, trackers, and visualizations that provide clear visibility into project performance, milestones, risks, financials, resources, and operational outcomes.
Analyze project, operational, financial, and business data to identify trends, gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities that support timely decision-making across Global Operations.
Support project managers and operational leaders with data analysis for project intake, prioritization, business cases, portfolio reviews, governance forums, and executive reporting.
Collect, clean, validate, and integrate data from multiple sources to ensure accurate, consistent, and reliable information for analysis and reporting.
Undertake research and prepare studies by collecting, reviewing, and analyzing internal and external data, including economic, technological, industry, customer, competitor, market, and operational information.
Translate complex data into concise insights, summaries, and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Support Agile and project management practices by maintaining work items, status updates, action logs, issue logs, RAID logs, and delivery metrics in relevant tools.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automate recurring analysis, strengthen data quality, and enhance project governance.
Collaborate with data engineering, development, and business teams to define data requirements and improve access to reliable project and operational data.
Follow UL Solutions’ Code of Conduct and all applicable data governance, physical security, digital security, and compliance practices.

Skills And Behaviors For Success

Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data, business context, and project outcomes.
Clear communicator who can simplify complex analysis for senior leaders, project teams, and operational stakeholders.
Detail-oriented and disciplined in data validation, documentation, follow-through, and quality of deliverables.
Collaborative working style with the ability to build trust across functions, regions, and levels of the organization.
Curious and proactive in identifying better ways to organize, analyze, visualize, and use data to support project delivery.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple priorities, shifting deadlines, and ambiguity.
Outcome-focused, with a practical understanding of how analytics supports execution, operational excellence, and business impact.

Qualifications

Experience, and Education

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
Typically 3 or more years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, project analytics, operational analytics, or a related role.
Experience supporting project management, program management, business operations, strategic initiatives, or portfolio reporting preferred.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Power BI; experience with Power Query, DAX, Tableau, or similar visualization tools preferred.
Working knowledge of SQL, data modeling, data validation, and data integration concepts; Python or R experience is a plus.
Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Planner, Smartsheet, Clarity, Jira, or similar tools preferred.
Understanding of project management practices, including milestone tracking, RAID management, status reporting, resource planning, budget tracking, and benefits realization.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to prepare clear summaries, dashboards, and executive-ready reporting.
PMP, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, Microsoft Power BI, or data analytics certification preferred but not required.

That’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. Our science is your advantage.

Our global network of 80+ laboratories is constantly evolving, because the world around us is always changing. Job Description

What you will do

Do you instinctively know how and when to take action? Do you love performing under intense pressure? As part of our Global Security group, you’ll help manage the security needs of our most valuable assets: our people and innovations. Along with your team, you’ll be part of an important system that protects employees and their work around the world. Your work will help create solutions to a variety of unique security challenges, ranging from the physical security of facilities to the protection of our supply chain. Join us, and you’ll play a meaningful role in preserving the highest standard of security for one of the most-watched companies in the world.

Imagine what you could do here. At Johnson Controls, Inc., new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. You will travel, talk to many people and help secure facilities and networks. Adventurous, dedicated and diligent people are heartily welcomed to our team. Our Global Security Operation’s and Technology group is seeking a Physical Security Project Coordinator to deliver solutions that support our growth and expansion. This position requires a mixed background in physical security operations, project management, and technology in the corporate space. You will assume ownership of specific Global Security projects, provide technical oversight, and coordinate responsibility for the on-time and on-budget completion of large, integrated solutions. You will deliver all solutions consistent with business objectives and to customer expectations; working closely with other business teams to ensure effective communication and collaboration, which are critical for success.

How you will do it

You will conduct and lead large-scale security and risk mitigation initiatives, applying CPTED principles, client standards, business processes, and practical experience to develop effective physical security plans that protect teammates, clients, and physical assets. You will lead projects by establishing priorities, defining measurable objectives, coordinating cross‑functional dependencies, planning resources, scheduling work, communicating updates, implementing solutions, and continuously monitoring and reporting on progress and results.

You will request and submit proposals, drawings, purchase orders, change orders, and invoices within required timeframes. You will collaborate closely with internal teams and business stakeholders to define project requirements and ensure all expectations are successfully met. You will guide team activities, resolve issues across all project areas, and maintain clear communication regarding project status and emerging issues with team members, management, and relevant partners.

You will provide effective project coordination and leadership to assigned resources and aligned partners to ensure deliverables are met. You will develop strong working relationships with Global Security managers to support precise execution across initiatives. You will actively monitor all projects to anticipate risks, address challenges, and implement mitigation plans as needed.

You will use financial acumen to estimate project costs, maintain budgets, and facilitate vendor payments. You will coordinate efforts among security, technical, and facilities suppliers involved in the project. You will develop and implement high‑quality solutions that align with Global Security and client standards and will review technical development deliverables for accuracy and completeness. You will promote sound management practices and help maintain a collaborative, productive environment.

You will create and maintain project plans and schedules, ensuring milestones are met and project documentation is accurately stored in the document repository. You are expected to be a self‑starter capable of quickly learning new processes and technologies with minimal assistance.

This role can be located in Orlando Florida and or Charlotte, NC.
